Term, renewal, lapse

  • Feed token expiry equals the Term end date.
  • On lapse: Licensee retains perpetual use of versions received during the Term; updates, feed access, and support end. Seats may not be increased after lapse.
  • Renewal at then-current list price unless agreed otherwise in writing.
